pr_title: fix(ct): setting ctTemplateDir does not work

issue_context.title: [BUG] A non-default ctTemplateDir does not work (component testing)
issue_context.body:
## Playwright: 
1.27.1
## System:
 - OS: Windows 10 10.0.19044
 - Memory: 6.67 GB / 31.67 GB
## Binaries:
 - Node: 16.15.0 - C:\Program Files\nodejs\node.EXE
 - Yarn: 1.22.4 - C:\Program Files (x86)\Yarn\bin\yarn.CMD
 - npm: 8.5.5 - C:\Program Files\nodejs\npm.CMD
## Languages:
 - Bash: 5.1.16 - C:\WINDOWS\system32\bash.EXE
## How to reproduce:
1. Unpack [pw-ct.zip](https://github.com/microsoft/playwright/files/9802979/pw-ct.zip)
2. Run `npm run test-ct` with the provided project → everything should be copacetic
3. Delete the `.cache` directory
4. Uncomment the line about `ctTemplateDir` in `playwright-ct.config.ts` and try again → the test file is found and compilation is successful but the test hangs and the browser (while it is hanging) shows a blank page 

Thus it seems that `./playwright` is hard-coded as the template directory.
comments: I can reproduce this with v1.27.1.
@olivier65 you could use `ctTemplateDir: 'playwright-ct'` instead of `ctTemplateDir: './playwright-ct'` for now until https://github.com/microsoft/playwright/pull/18152 is released

review_comments: If relativeTemplateDir contains forward slashes, this still won't work on Windows I am afraid.
Tested it on Windows and it works. Used `path.resolve` and `path.join` to convert all slashes to either `\` on Windows or `/` on POSTFIX before the `endsWith` comparison
